statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is not explicitly listed as a single line item. It has been calculated by summing the values from 'Net increase in depreciation, amortization and provisions' and 'Depreciation of right-of-use assets' for each year, as these are the two components that together represent total depreciation and amortization expense added back in the cash flow statement. The 'Other adjustments and computed expenses' line was not included as it contains other non-cash items.
